title: echioglossum chantaburiense
intro: Echioglossum chantaburiense, commonly known as Chantaburi echioglossum, is a type of flowering plant in the lily family. It is a perennial plant that has been traditionally used in Southeast Asia for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Echioglossum chantaburiense include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can help to reduce pain and inflammation in the body. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as sedative, anti-anxiety, and antimicrobial effects.
